questions.stem: A call-center app must show supervisors a transcript a few seconds after speech is heard on a live phone stream. Which Speech capability should you use?

options.text: Batch transcription of recorded WAV files
Real-time speech to text on the audio stream
Text to speech with a custom neural voice

questions.explanation: Live streams need low-latency real-time speech to text. Batch jobs wait for a finished recording. TTS speaks text; it does not transcribe.

questions.stem: An agent must extract tables and QR codes from scanned PDF invoices and keep the original layout for downstream mapping. You cannot deploy a language model. Which Content Understanding analyzer should you use?
questions.explanation: prebuilt-layout returns structure (paragraphs, tables, selection marks, barcodes/QR) without a custom LLM. prebuilt-read is OCR-first. Search analyzers do not preserve layout for mapping.

questions.stem: Users upload screenshots that may contain hidden prompt-injection text. You must stop the attack from reaching the multimodal model and treat third-party content as lower trust. What should you configure?

options.text: Prompt shields action = annotate, and disable Spotlighting
Prompt shields action = block, and enable Spotlighting
A custom blocklist of the word screenshot
OCR only, with no prompt shield

questions.explanation: Block stops a detected document attack. Spotlighting marks untrusted extracted content so the model is less likely to follow it. Annotate only flags. Blocklists and OCR do not establish trust boundaries.

questions.stem: Match each agent requirement to the built-in tool.

slots.label: Answer from files the user just uploaded

questions.explanation: Code interpreter runs Python. Bing grounding fetches current public web facts. File search indexes uploads for RAG. Computer use drives GUIs. Fabric is an analytics platform, not these three tools.

questions.stem: Several apps must share one Azure AI Search configuration. Key-based auth is banned and you want the least admin work. What should you do?

options.text: Create a custom HTTP connection in each app
Create an Azure AI Search connection in the Foundry project and reuse it
Call Search directly from every app with its own settings
Store the query key in each app settings file

questions.explanation: A project connection centralizes endpoint and Entra-based auth so every client reuses one configuration.

questions.stem: You must inspect one agent run and see the ordered LLM calls, tool calls, and timings. Which observability feature is that?
questions.explanation: Tracing is per-run, step-ordered telemetry. Token usage is volume only. Safety metrics score harm. Cost analysis is billing.

questions.stem: An OpenAPI tool must send an API key from a Foundry connection in an HTTP header automatically. What do you add to the OpenAPI specification?

options.text: A header parameter on every operation only
An Azure Key Vault connection name in the summary

questions.explanation: An API key security scheme tells the OpenAPI tool how to inject the connection secret (header, query, or cookie).

questions.stem: A ticket-triage agent sometimes answers without calling any tool. You must force a tool call. Which tool_choice value do you set?
questions.explanation: required makes the model invoke at least one tool before it replies. auto may skip tools.

questions.stem: A GitHub Actions workflow must compare a new agent against the latest approved evaluation baseline and fail the job if scores regress past tolerance. Which two settings do you use?

options.text: Compare against the latest approved baseline
Compare against the previous workflow run only
Fail the workflow if regression exceeds tolerance
Ignore evaluation and deploy on any green build

questions.explanation: The approved baseline is the quality gate, not an arbitrary prior run. Failing the workflow stops a regressing deploy.

questions.stem: A RAG agent must stay faithful to retrieved chunks before a pull request can merge. Which evaluation should the pipeline run?

options.text: Groundedness evaluation, and require the workflow to succeed

questions.explanation: Groundedness checks claims against retrieved context. Requiring a successful workflow blocks the merge when quality fails.

questions.stem: You need a centralized SIEM that correlates Foundry, Defender, and Entra alerts. What do you pair with a Log Analytics workspace?
questions.explanation: Sentinel is the SIEM/SOAR that sits on a Log Analytics workspace and correlates those security signals.

questions.stem: A legal research agent must remember attorney preferences across sessions and search PDFs uploaded in the current chat. What do you enable?

options.text: Persistent agent memory and File search

questions.explanation: Persistent memory survives sessions. File search indexes uploads. History and prompt cache do not store long-term preferences.

questions.stem: Content Safety must read engineering drawings from Blob Storage without storage keys or SAS, using least privilege. What do you use?

options.text: System-assigned managed identity and Storage Blob Data Reader
A user-delegation SAS cached in the prompt
Storage Blob Data Contributor on a shared key

questions.explanation: A system-assigned identity plus Blob Data Reader is Entra auth and read-only. Keys, SAS, and Owner violate the constraints.

questions.stem: You must replace only the sky in a photo and leave the foreground untouched, using built-in image editing. What do you configure?

options.text: mask inpainting with a mask over the sky

questions.explanation: Mask inpainting edits only the masked region. The other modes change the whole image or generate a new one.

questions.stem: A LangChain service and Foundry Agent Service share one Application Insights resource. Company policy says telemetry must be distinguishable and secrets must not appear in spans.

items.text: LangChain traces appear automatically with no OpenTelemetry tracer.
Different OTEL_SERVICE_NAME values help separate the two services.
enable_content_recording=False still captures full prompts and tool payloads.

questions.explanation: LangChain needs an Azure OpenTelemetry tracer. Service name splits apps in the same workspace. Disabling content recording is how you avoid storing prompt and tool secrets.

questions.stem: You connect a Python app to a Foundry model with the Azure OpenAI SDK. Which three values do you typically need?

options.text: Deployment name, endpoint, and key (or Entra credential)
Subscription ID and a Bing key
The resource group and SKU only

questions.explanation: The SDK targets a deployment at an endpoint and authenticates with a key or Entra credential. Model family name alone is not enough.

questions.stem: You need numeric vectors so two documents can be compared for semantic similarity. What do you generate?
questions.explanation: Embeddings are numeric vectors designed for similarity. Chat, image, and speech APIs do not return document vectors.

questions.stem: After you train an Azure Custom Vision classifier, which two metrics are available to review?
questions.explanation: Custom Vision reports precision and recall (and related classification metrics), not infrastructure or unrelated KPIs.

questions.stem: You will train Azure Custom Vision to flag faulty factory parts. Put the first three actions in order.
questions.explanation: Create the project, label images, then train. Object detection is a different project type if you only need classify-faulty vs good.

questions.stem: An agent must give a personalized experience across future sessions, recalling earlier preferences. What do you add?
questions.explanation: Memory is what persists user context across sessions. Knowledge is source content. Guardrails enforce policy. Tools call APIs.
